commit.message:
fix: apply graph-contract review findings

- runtime: use performance.now() for monotonic telemetry durations (was Date.now()).
- guards: validate result.output is present in guardJudgmentValid (was only invocationId).
- fde-graph: add run.retry-ready / run.completed / run.aborted terminal nodes and point the retry/complete/abort edges at them.
- generators: annotate Mermaid edge labels with the phase-change so abort from-phases are visible.
- regenerate docs/graph/generated.md.

refactor: deduplicate FRAME_BLOCKED / CLARIFICATION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED

Single-source the three duplicated constants:

- FRAME_BLOCKED + CLARIFICATION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED now live in src/core/errors.ts (guards.ts imports and re-exports them for the graph package).
- DEFAULT_CLARIFICATION_BUDGET stays in src/graph/guards.ts.
- Drop the orchestrator's duplicate FRAME_BLOCKED (now imported) and its dead CLARIFICATION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / DEFAULT_CLARIFICATION_BUDGET exports.

This removes the no-compile-time-pin drift hazard between the orchestrator and the guard registry.

feat: add governance + graph versioning (Phase 5)

Close the Agent Graph migration with the governance/versioning layer:

- G5-03 graphVersion: GRAPH_VERSION stamped into run.started (optional, backward-compatible) so a run replays under the graph it was started with.
- G5-01 auto-docs: scripts/generate-docs.mjs emits docs/graph/generated.md (Mermaid + edge catalog + phase transitions) with graph validation baked in.
- G5-02 contract tests: guard-reference check (no ghost guard) in graph-ir.test.ts.
- G5-04 release gate: npm ci -> typecheck -> build -> test -> graph-validation+doc-gen -> generated-doc drift.

Verified: typecheck, build, 943 tests, full 6-step release gate green.

feat: add execution telemetry (Phase 4)

Add the observability layer, separate from the deterministic domain event log:

- src/telemetry/types.ts: NodeSpan (G4-01) + EdgeSpan (G4-02) + TokenUsage/NodeOutcome.
- src/telemetry/collector.ts: TelemetryCollector port + InMemoryCollector.
- src/telemetry/metrics.ts: aggregateNodeMetrics (counts, p50/p95, retries, invalid-output, tokens, max/stuck duration).
- src/graph/runtime.ts: dispatchNode/dispatchWithRetry emit a NodeSpan per attempt when a collector is supplied (wall-clock skipped when no collector, preserving determinism).

G4-03 (JudgmentEnvelope) is already covered by src/core/judgment.ts (JudgmentProvenance). Telemetry never enters the hash payload; losing it never affects recovery.

Verified: typecheck, build, 942 tests, release gate green.

feat: node-ize the orchestrator (Phase 3 integration)

Wire all four subgraphs into the orchestrator as the live runtime:

- Discovery: prepareDiscoveryTurn dispatches the 8 discovery node handlers.
- Framing: prepareFramingGate + prepareClarification dispatch the 6 framing handlers.
- Challenge: prepareChallengeInjection + prepareRespondToChallenge dispatch the 7 challenge handlers.
- Review: prepareReview dispatches the review handlers in the reconciled order (coach -> input.build(with criterionScores) -> score.compute -> profile.effect -> review.commit); the standalone judgment.guard is dropped (embedded in the coach).

Add the graph-runtime dispatcher (dispatchNode/dispatchWithRetry + failure-code extraction + per-failure-class disposition -> PendingNodeExecution). Remove the now-dead inline helpers. Orchestrator shrinks 1244 -> ~1050 lines.

Verified: typecheck, build, 935 tests, release gate all green.

feat: node-ize the four subgraphs (Phase 3 foundation)

Add the Phase 3 foundation and the four subgraph node handlers:

- G3-05 failure policy (per-failure-class disposition + defaults).
- G3-06 pending execution (single-slot PendingNodeExecution fold + resumability).
- node-handler contract (NodeHandler/NodeExecution/NodeRuntime).
- Discovery / Problem Framing / Challenge / Review subgraphs as independent, tested NodeHandlers (33 tests) that re-implement the orchestrator's prepare* logic without importing it (no cycle).

The graph-runtime dispatch and orchestrator integration (the serial two-slice swap) remain the next step.

feat: migrate control flow to an explicit Agent Graph (Phases 0-2)

Wave 0 (baseline): docs/graph/ current-system catalogs (phase matrix, node/edge catalogs) + integration record.

Terminal wiring: wire complete/abort/start-retry and restructure retry into a two-step flow (retry: REVIEW->RETRY_READY; start-retry: spawn child at DISCOVERY) matching docs/architecture.md; retry.started now carries focusSummaries.

Phase 0.5 (graph spec): src/graph/ contract (ActionId, EventProtocolSpec), phase-spec (PHASE_EDGES/PHASE_TRANSITIONS), event-protocol registry, challenge-state reducer. assertCommandPhase is now derived from PHASE_EDGES.

Phase 1 (correctness): event-batch validator (rejects illegal batches pre-journal), strict replay validator (fail-closed at loadRun), challenge-aggregate wiring (replaces caller-tracked mandatoryChallengeIds with folded injectedChallenges).

Phase 2 (Graph IR): types/definition/fde-graph/guards (10 pure guards)/validator (static)/generators (Mermaid); assertCommandPhase derived from the spec.

Verified: typecheck, build, 887 tests, release:gate all green.

the explicit FDE_GYM_MODEL_BASE_URL/FDE_GYM_MODEL env vars only.

fix: correct confidence formula + tie-break + empty-criteria; validate samples; parallel sampling

- confidence divides by 50 (not 100) so it spans [0,1]; null when no criterion scores
- tie-break deprioritizes no-criteria reviews (distance = Infinity)
- reject 0/negative/fractional/NaN samples in prepareReview (was silently coerced)
- sampleFinalReview runs the N invocations concurrently (Promise.all)
- samples error is a plain Error, not the misleading COACH_OUTPUT_REJECTED

feat: add sampleFinalReview (N final-review invocations)
